name: Ancestral Keg spawns its gameobject (#5153, #4258)
contract: Ancestral Keg 804748 is SPELL_EFFECT_TRANS_DOOR with EffectMiscValue 9000118 (Spell.dbc). Spell::EffectTransmitted (SpellEffects.cpp) looks the id up with sObjectMgr->GetGameObjectTemplate and silently returns, logging an error, when the row is missing; no gameobject_template row for 9000118 existed anywhere before this fix, so the cast animation played but nothing was ever placed. The new pending_db_world migration adds gameobject_template entry 9000118 (type 22 GAMEOBJECT_TYPE_SPELLCASTER, displayId 1011172, name 'Ancestral Keg', sourced from hertigservices/ascension-data exiles-db-export-2026-09-13), so the cast must now leave exactly one owned gameobject of that entry near the caster.

steps.label: No Ancestral Keg object exists yet
The Ancestral Keg gameobject is placed near the caster
